200:t_1:3.en: ～$$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace～

200:t_1:8.en:
$$執務官$$
「You are now granted an audience with His Majesty $$アウストラリス$$, Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$.」

200:t_1:10.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Your Majesty $$アウストラリス$$... My name is $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$, Vice Foreign Minister of the $$地球連邦$$.」

200:t_1:12.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Now that I'm here, I won't question how I got here. I intend to make the most of this opportunity to speak with you.」

200:t_1:13.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Tell us why you invaded Earth. If migration or energy problems are the reason, the Federation government is willing to negotiate.」

200:t_1:15.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Why on earth have you come to this planet?」

200:t_1:16.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Is your aim to extract Earth's $$次元力$$ through the $$レイライン$$ network you've spread across it?」

200:t_1:21.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「We are finished. Take them away.」

200:t_1:22.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Please wait! We haven't finished talking!」

200:t_1:24.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「Do you think such lawlessness will be tolerated forever!?」

200:t_1:25.en:
$$執務官$$
「Know your place, Earthlings. You are in His Majesty's presence!」

200:t_1:26.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「They will be useful. Treat them courteously.」

200:t_1:29.en:
$$執務官$$
「Come with me. You will be given a new role.」

200:t_1:30.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...Those entrusted with this planet's future... They are strong.」

200:t_1:31.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「But words can protect nothing...」

200:t_1:38.en:
$n
「Thank you for your hard work scouting ahead too, Major $$カリーニン$$.」

200:t_1:39.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...This was a beautiful city once...」

200:t_1:41.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I came here on a mission.」

200:t_1:42.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「$l... What do you think of the world as it is now?」

200:t_1:44.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Don't you think it's wrong?」

200:t_1:45.en:
$n
「A world where innocent lives are taken... I can't believe that's right.」

200:t_1:46.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Then what should we do?」

200:t_1:47.en:
$n
「We should defeat the Empire as soon as possible and...」

200:t_1:48.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...That won't solve the fundamental problem.」

200:t_1:52.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I have a report on $$ラース・バビロン$$ to deliver. I'll head back first.」

200:t_1:53.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「$l... I'm counting on you to look after $$相良$$.」

200:t_1:55.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Was that Major $$カリーニン$$ just now?」

200:t_1:57.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You looked troubled. What were you talking about?」

200:t_1:59.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The attack on $$ラース・バビロン$$... If we can just succeed...」

200:t_1:62.en:
$n
(They're... different from our previous enemies... To beat them, I'll need to...)

200:t_1:67.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room～

200:t_1:68.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...So $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ was traveling all over the world and singing.」

200:t_1:69.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Under these circumstances, it wasn't as carefree as it sounds.」

200:t_1:70.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Actually, $$サイデリアル$$ was chasing us the whole time. We were singing while we ran.」

200:t_1:71.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Well... We were doing the same thing we did in $c. Business as usual, basically.」

200:t_1:72.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「It's because you're like that as bandleader, $$レイ#pt231$$, that $$バサラ$$ gets carried away!」

200:t_1:73.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Um... $$ミレーヌ$$... $$バサラ$$ himself isn't listening...」

200:t_1:75.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「What's that supposed to be!? Are you imitating $$キリコ$$!? Or are you asleep!?」

200:t_1:76.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Shut up... I'm concentrating on the next concert.」

200:t_1:77.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「The next concert... You mean the attack on $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

200:t_1:78.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You bet. I'll make it the biggest, best show ever.」

200:t_1:79.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Isn't that amazing, $$レド$$!? $$バサラ$$ really does sing anywhere!」

200:t_1:82.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't understand him at all...」

200:t_1:83.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is also unable to explain his behavior logically.」

200:t_1:84.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Ensign $$レド$$... Major $$オズマ$$ has told me about you.」

200:t_1:85.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「He also told me you've spent most of your life fighting and never had a chance to experience culture.」

200:t_1:87.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The term refers broadly to humanity's productive activities. In the $$人類銀河同盟$$, it is encountered only in limited settings.」

200:t_1:88.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「What did you think when you heard $$バサラ$$'s songs?」
